headline: Approved 44-unit senior apartment project at 860 Lisbon Street and granted two-year extensions for two other housing developments, all 6-0.
summary: The board held a public hearing and approved, 6-0, a development review application for a four-story, 44-unit senior apartment building at 860 Lisbon Street with six conditions. The board also granted 6-0 two-year construction extensions for Martel School Apartments Phase 2 and for Soliel Apartments Phases 1 and 2 at 61 Ash Street, both until August 12, 2028. The board continued the election of a secretary and the appointment of a Forestry Board representative until more members are present, and discussed ordinance update processes, outreach on vacant building rules, and clarifications from the July 27 meeting.
decisions: Continued the election of a board secretary until all current board members are present, with no set date.
Approved the 44-unit, four-story apartment building application at 860 Lisbon Street with six conditions, 6-0.
Granted a two-year extension, until August 12, 2028, to start construction on Martel School Apartments Phase 2 at 860 Lisbon Street, 6-0.
Granted a two-year extension, until August 12, 2028, to start construction on Soliel Apartments Phases 1 and 2 at 61 Ash Street, 6-0.
Continued the appointment of a Planning Board representative to the Forestry Board until more regular members are present.

decision_evidence.quote: by Alexander Pine to continue the election of secretary until all the current board members are present (not a date certain)... VOTED: 6-0 (Passed).

the application submitted by the Lewiston Housing Authority and Lewiston Auburn Area Housing Development Corporation, for a new four-story apartment building containing 44 dwelling units at 860 Lisbon Street, meets all of the necessary criteria...approval be granted with the following conditions...VOTED: 6-0 (Passed)

to grant a two-year extension of the August 12, 2024, development review approval to Lewiston Housing Authority and Lewiston Auburn Area Housing Development Corporation for the amendment of the development review of Phase 2 of the Martell School Apartments at 860 Lisbon Street, until August 12, 2028, to start construction...VOTED: 6-0 (passed).
